mods.name: RagnaCustomsApi
mods.author: Brollyy
mods.description: Reusable UE4SS Lua library for the RagnaCustoms catalog, downloads, and voting APIs.

releases.changelog: Handle HTTP request failures and report them to consumers; add a game-thread status fallback for UE4SS environments; prevent duplicate request completion; and improve generic HTTP transport diagnostics. No API contract changes. Requires RagnaModManager >=1.1.0.

mods.name: RagnaCustomsVote
mods.author: Brollyy
mods.description: UE4SS Lua mod adding custom-song voting controls to Ragnarock Results screens.

releases.changelog: Add upvote and downvote controls to the custom-song Results screen; use the canonical RagnaCustoms WanApi voting contract; read configured CustomApiUrls; show vote state and updated counts; and handle rejected requests with an in-game retry state. Requires RagnaCustomsApi >=0.2.0 and a game CustomApiUrls entry for the RagnaCustoms WanApi endpoint.
